falsification_criteria: Cosine similarity remains below 0.20 after full training with the expanded hidden width
Latent MSE increases significantly (>0.06) while cosine similarity fails to improve
Training loss exhibits persistent oscillation or divergence despite larger capacity
hypotheses.mechanism: Increasing the hidden layer width expands the function approximation capacity of the predictor network, allowing it to capture higher-order dynamic interactions and align predicted latent vectors with ground-truth directions. This should raise cosine similarity while maintaining or slightly reducing latent MSE, without triggering optimization instability.
hypotheses.statement: The dominant failure is insufficient_model_capacity, evidenced by critically low cosine similarity (~0.08–0.17) across all prediction horizons despite moderate latent MSE (~0.046–0.050), indicating the predictor lacks sufficient representational power to resolve directional trajectory dependencies.
hypotheses.title: Insufficient Model Capacity Limits Latent Alignment
